# AuthenticateResponse

A signed-in session: its token, the user it belongs to and their tenant's name.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `authenticationToken` | [`AuthenticationToken`](authentication-token.md) | The session token to send as a bearer token, and when it expires. |
| `user` | [`User`](user.md) | The signed-in user. |
| `tenantName` | `string` | The name of the user's tenant. |

## Example

```json
{
  "authenticationToken": {
    "expires": "2026-10-26T12:00:00.0000000Z",
    "token": "..."
  },
  "user": {
    "name": "...",
    "emailAddress": "...",
    "isEnabled": false,
    "roles": [
      "..."
    ],
    "isEmailAddressVerified": false,
    "tenantId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
    "id": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
    "dateCreated": "2026-10-26T12:00:00.0000000Z",
    "dateUpdated": "2026-10-26T12:00:00.0000000Z"
  },
  "tenantName": "..."
}
```
